name: Web Studio
description: Create live projects for websites, mini-apps, visualizations, documents, spreadsheets, and presentations.
author: mobius-os

project_templates.name: Website
project_templates.description: Build a local website with project chats and a previewable website artifact.
project_templates.guidance: Work directly inside the project root. Keep index.html and every local asset together, avoid external load-time dependencies, and build the HTML entry as a website artifact.

project_templates.name: Mini-app
project_templates.description: Build a real React mini-app package with a live browser artifact.
project_templates.guidance: Treat index.jsx as the app entry and mobius.json as its package contract. Build one useful interaction first, keep it keyboard-accessible and self-contained, and verify the browser artifact after meaningful changes.

project_templates.name: Interactive visualization
project_templates.description: Explore first-class data and rendering source through a presentation-ready chart.
project_templates.guidance: Keep sample data in data.js and rendering behavior in visualization.js. Prioritize legible labels, keyboard interaction, an informative empty state, and no external load-time dependencies.

project_templates.name: Document
project_templates.description: Draft in Markdown with a live reading view and a typeset document artifact.
project_templates.guidance: Write for the reader in document.md. Use semantic headings, concise sections, lists, emphasis, links, and blockquotes; save to rebuild the self-contained reading artifact.

project_templates.name: Spreadsheet
project_templates.description: Edit durable CSV cells in a live grid and publish a responsive data view.
project_templates.guidance: Treat sheet.csv as the source of truth. Keep a clear header row and one record per row; use the grid editor for routine changes and rebuild the self-contained data artifact after saving.

project_templates.name: Presentation
project_templates.description: Shape a responsive narrative deck with a live, presentation-ready preview.
project_templates.guidance: Build the story directly in index.html. Keep every slide semantic, concise, keyboard-accessible, responsive, and self-contained without external load-time dependencies.
